'''Calculator''' was a [[Subnode|subsystem]] of the [[Assembler]] known as [[Kud'ar Mub'at]]. It was skilled at mathematical calculations<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|104|Calculator}}</ref> and interpreting data.<ref name="EGTAS">''[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|The Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> Calculator was not involved in the handling of Mub'at's finances, which were the province of [[BalanceSheet]].<ref name="CSWE" />
